diagnosis: The final simplification unfolds only the coefficient sum, leaving evaluations of the intermediate novel basis opaque; `ring` therefore treats the essential basis-recursion terms as unrelated atoms. Unfold the intermediate basis and normalized quotient polynomials before normalization.
proof_body:
by
  classical
  simp only
  intro y
  unfold fold
  dsimp only
  have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β (i := i)
    (h_i_add_1 := by omega) (y := y) (k := (0 : Fin 2))
  have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β (i := i)
    (h_i_add_1 := by omega) (y := y) (k := (1 : Fin 2))
  simp only at h0 h1
  rw [h0, h1]
  simp [Fin2ToF2, intermediateEvaluationPoly, intermediateNovelBasisX,
    intermediateNormVpoly] <;> ring_nf
